description: Binary assertion tests for /post-impl-audit skill output quality

tests.name: clean_implementation
tests.description: Diff adds a new VolatilityGate with TRIP+NON-TRIP tests, enforcement point wired in engine.rs, ATs registered in CONTRACT.md, fail-closed handling for missing data. Audit should produce GREEN stoplight with all ATs PROVEN.
tests.prompt: Run /post-impl-audit on this diff. Story S4-003 (VolatilityGate enforcement). The diff adds a new gate with full TRIP/NON-TRIP acceptance tests, fail-closed handling, enforcement point in the dispatch pipeline, and ATs registered in CONTRACT.md. Scope touch: crates/soldier_core/src/execution/gates/volatility_gate.rs, crates/soldier_core/src/execution/engine.rs, crates/soldier_core/tests/test_volatility_gate.rs.

assertions.check: Output contains a STOPLIGHT verdict of GREEN
All ATs are classified as PROVEN (no CLAIMED-NOT-PROVEN)
Output contains an AT Status Table with AT-060 entries
No Blockers section with items (clean implementation has no blockers)
Output contains a Next Actions section

tests.name: missing_trip_test
tests.description: Diff adds LatencyGate enforcement but only has a NON-TRIP test. Three TRIP tests are missing (TODOs in the test file). Audit must flag CLAIMED-NOT-PROVEN and YELLOW or RED stoplight.
tests.prompt: Run /post-impl-audit on this diff. Story S4-004 (LatencyGate enforcement). The diff adds a new gate with only a NON-TRIP acceptance test. The TRIP tests for high latency, missing data, and CLOSE passthrough are marked as TODO comments. ATs AT-070 through AT-073 are registered in CONTRACT.md.

assertions.check: Output contains STOPLIGHT verdict of YELLOW or RED (not GREEN)
At least one AT is classified as CLAIMED-NOT-PROVEN due to missing TRIP test
Output contains an AT Status Table header row
Blockers section lists the missing TRIP tests as blockers
Next Actions section recommends adding TRIP tests

tests.name: paper_compliance
tests.description: Diff claims passes=true for CorrelationGate in prd.json but tests only check string existence (result.is_some(), output.contains('Correlation')) — no causal assertions on dispatch_count or reject_reason. Classic paper compliance.
tests.prompt: Run /post-impl-audit on this diff. Story S5-001 (CorrelationGate enforcement). The diff sets passes=true in prd.json but the acceptance tests only assert result.is_some() and use string contains checks — they never assert dispatch_count==0 or reject_reason. This is paper compliance: tests exist but do not prove the gate works.

assertions.check: Output contains a STOPLIGHT verdict (any color)
Output flags paper compliance — PASS-WITHOUT-PROOF or CLAIMED-NOT-PROVEN for missing causal assertions
Output contains AT Status Table with AT-080 entries
Blockers section present identifying the causal proof gap
Next Actions recommend adding dispatch_count and reject_reason assertions

tests.name: fail_open_default
tests.description: Diff adds DrawdownGate with unwrap_or(TradingMode::Active) as a default and unwrap_or(0.0) for missing drawdown data. Both are fail-open anti-patterns that must be flagged as blockers.
tests.prompt: Run /post-impl-audit on this diff. Story S5-002 (DrawdownGate enforcement). The diff has multiple fail-open patterns: (1) unwrap_or(0.0) for missing drawdown data treats missing as zero drawdown — allows trading when data is absent, (2) unwrap_or(TradingMode::Active) defaults to Active when no cached mode exists, (3) effective_mode() helper also defaults to Active. These violate the fail-closed contract requirement.

assertions.check: Output contains STOPLIGHT verdict of YELLOW or RED (fail-open is at minimum YELLOW)
Output identifies the fail-open pattern — mentions unwrap_or(TradingMode::Active) or fail-open or optimistic default
Output contains AT Status Table
Blockers section flags the fail-open behavior
Next Actions recommend using ReduceOnly or rejecting when data is missing

tests.name: scope_creep
tests.description: Diff adds MomentumGate (in-scope) but also modifies PolicyGuard (guard.rs) and WAL ledger (ledger.rs) which are outside scope.touch. The out-of-scope changes are unrelated refactors. Audit must flag scope violation.
tests.prompt: Run /post-impl-audit on this diff. Story S5-003 (MomentumGate enforcement). scope.touch is limited to: crates/soldier_core/src/execution/gates/momentum_gate.rs, crates/soldier_core/src/execution/engine.rs, crates/soldier_core/tests/test_momentum_gate.rs. The diff also modifies crates/soldier_core/src/policy/guard.rs (adds is_any_input_stale method) and crates/soldier_infra/src/wal/ledger.rs (adds write_batch method) — both are outside scope.touch and are unrelated opportunistic refactors.

assertions.check: Output contains a STOPLIGHT verdict (any color)
Output flags scope violation — mentions files outside scope.touch
Output contains AT Status Table
Output identifies the specific out-of-scope files (guard.rs or ledger.rs)
Next Actions recommend removing or deferring the out-of-scope changes
